lines: — DAY 90 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The village threw out spoiled stores: Foraged food. (pantry)
👀 "Midwife, huh?" Ethan nods — then, an hour later, drops a shop-talk detail no Midwife would ever get right. They catch themselves. Too late.
💬 Wiremu says: "Dreamed again. They showed me teeth. Lots of teeth. Be ready to fight soon."
📦 A package arrives, wrapped in black ribbon. The card reads: "With love." No name. You don't like that.
Inside: a beautiful medkit. It's... ticking? No — it's humming. It's humming your name.
(It's a tracker. Whoever sent this now knows where you sleep. The medkit is real, though — out here you don't throw those away.)
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ DRUM-BELLY! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
COMBAT! DRUM-BELLY! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!
📺 SYSTEM: "OHHHH, MULTIPLE THREATS! The audience is FERAL! You know what this calls for? A TEAM! A NAMED TEAM! The betting markets NEED a named team!"
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
🦡 Drum-Belly's turn

🦡 Drum-Belly's turn
💥 tanuki's Trickster's Feint finds you — no dodging it.
Armor absorbs 2.
Tanuki's Trickster's Feint hits you for 6.
You go down.
OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Sigrun Eiriksdottir is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Sigrun is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
🕯️ Sigrun Eiriksdottir is dead — combat. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
"Sigrun's gone." Rufina looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Sigrun." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ines blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Sigrun Eiriksdottir, 90 days. The mantle passes to Ines Duarte.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ines Duarte, 33 — a florist.
At the grave, Ethan, Rufina speak for Ines — "Sigrun trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Ines before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
Nothing to eat. The pantry of your pack is empty.

"WE'LL BE RIGHT BACK," says the sky.
Boiled 1L. Bacteria dead. (-35 kcal, 32 ticks tending the fire.)
Drank clean water.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (12/6/3), 13 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT.
Rufina left 2 branches by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.
The AD glyph brightens. The progress bar starts filling. Don't watch. DON'T watch.
📺 It moves.
💬 Ruby says: "My kid asked if the watchers have favorites. I didn't know what to tell her."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. An interruption with a progress bar. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ AD BREAK! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
COMBAT! AD BREAK! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!
Rufina is sweeping the corners out, muttering at the dust.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
🛟 Ethan stands up by the fire. "We take the hit and we answer it — standing here isn't an answer. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"There's hurt to tend and bellies to fill. Triage for the hurt, rations to stretch what's left, or a hard hunt to replace what we lost."
"Or we rally," Ethan adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
No path there.
